BAB III
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN
Part One
Women's Empowerment

Article 33
Other violence as referred to in Article 27 letter f is caused by:
a. threat of violence includes: any unlawful act in the form of words, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, whether with or without using means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom; and
b. coercion, includes: a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something contrary to their own will.

Article 5
(1) In order to enhance the position, role, and quality of women, as well as efforts to realize gender equality and justice in family life, society, nationhood, and statehood, women must be empowered.
(2) The empowerment of women as referred to in paragraph (1) is directed toward obtaining opportunities and their rights as human beings, so that they are able to play a role and participate in economic, socio-cultural, political, and legal activities.
